title: should login with valid credentials and navigate to products page
expected: User redirected to /ecommerce showing Products heading with product cards

title: should show error for invalid email
steps: Enter invalid email and valid password
expected: Error message displayed, user stays on login page

title: should show error for invalid password
steps: Enter valid email and wrong password
expected: Error message displayed, user stays on login page

title: should show error for empty fields
steps: Click LOGIN button without entering credentials
expected: Error message displayed for required fields

title: should display all 9 products on products page
expected: 9 product cards displayed with names, descriptions, images, and Add to cart buttons

title: should sort products A to Z ascending
preconditions: User is logged in on products page
expected: First product is Sample Jacket Name (id=3 or id=7)

title: should sort products Z to A descending
preconditions: User is logged in on products page
expected: First product is Sample Trouser Name

title: should sort products by price low to high
preconditions: User is logged in on products page
expected: Products ordered by price ascending

title: should sort products by price high to low
preconditions: User is logged in on products page
expected: Products ordered by price descending

title: should navigate to product detail page and show product info
preconditions: User is logged in on products page
steps: Verify product name, image, quantity controls visible
expected: Product detail page shows name 'Sample Shirt Name', image, quantity input (default 1), +/- buttons, Add to cart button, Back to Products button

title: should increment and decrement quantity on product detail page
preconditions: User is on product detail page for product 1
expected: Quantity correctly increments and decrements

title: should add product to cart from detail page with quantity
preconditions: User is on product detail page for product 1
steps: Verify product in cart with quantity 2
expected: Cart badge shows count, cart page shows product with correct quantity

title: should navigate back to products from detail page
preconditions: User is on product detail page
expected: User returns to /ecommerce products listing

title: should add product to cart from products listing
preconditions: User is logged in, cart is empty
steps: Verify button changes to 'Remove from cart'
expected: Product added to cart, button text updates, badge shows count

title: should remove product from cart on products page
steps: On products page, click 'Remove from cart' on product 1
Verify button changes back to 'Add to cart'
expected: Product removed from cart, button reverts, badge hidden

title: should display cart items correctly
preconditions: Product 1 is in cart with qty 1
steps: Verify product name, image, remove button, quantity controls
Verify Continue Shopping and Checkout buttons visible
expected: Cart shows added products with correct details and controls

title: should remove product from cart page
expected: Product removed, cart is empty

title: should update quantity in cart using +/- buttons
preconditions: Product 1 is in cart with qty 1
expected: Cart quantity updates correctly

title: should navigate back to products via Continue Shopping
expected: User returns to products listing at /ecommerce

title: should complete full checkout flow successfully
preconditions: Product in cart, user on cart page
steps: Click Checkout button on cart page
Fill first name, last name, zip code
Verify checkout overview or confirmation page
expected: User completes checkout and sees order confirmation

title: should cancel checkout and return to cart
steps: Verify user returns to cart page
expected: Cart page displayed with items preserved

title: should show validation error for empty required fields in checkout
steps: On checkout-info page, leave all fields empty
expected: Validation errors shown for required fields

title: should add product to favorites from products page
preconditions: User is logged in, no favorites
steps: On products page, click heart/favorite icon on product 1
expected: Product added to favorites, heart icon toggled

title: should display favorite products on favorites page
steps: Navigate to favorites page via user dropdown
expected: Favorites page shows added favorites or empty state message

title: should show empty state when no favorites exist
steps: Verify empty state message 'You have no favorite products'
expected: Empty state message displayed with Continue Shopping link

title: should navigate to favorites from user dropdown menu
steps: Click user email button to open dropdown
expected: Favorites page displayed

title: should logout and redirect to login page
steps: Click user email button to open dropdown
expected: User logged out, login page displayed

title: should persist cart across page navigation
expected: Cart contents persist across navigation

title: should add multiple different products to cart
expected: Cart contains all 3 products with correct names

title: should display correct product info for different products
steps: Navigate to product details for id=1, verify name is 'Sample Shirt Name'
Navigate to product details for id=2, verify name is 'Sample Shoe Name'
Navigate to product details for id=5, verify name is 'Sample T-Shirt Name'
expected: Each product detail page shows correct product name and info
